description: The plot illustrates the first token attention scores of the baseline model across different layers. The x-axis is labeled "layer" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20 with a tick label interval of 5. The y-axis is labeled "first token attention score" and also has a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with a tick label interval of 0.2. There are two lines in the plot: a solid blue line representing the "first token attention score" and a dashed black line representing the "mean: 0.467". The solid blue line starts at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, increases to around 0.6 at layer 5, and then fluctuates between 0.4 and 0.8 across the remaining layers, ending at approximately 0.45 at layer 20, with a peak of around 0.8 at layer 6 and another peak of about 0.75 at layer 19. The dashed black line remains constant at 0.467 across all layers.
